coordinates: Centres converted from midships to AP by adding 60.85 m; y starboard; z baseline.

arrangement.note: Simplified tank footprints for selection, not surveyed boundaries or liquid levels. Capacities and calculations retain the sounding-table data; the arrangement and ballast-management capacity summaries differ from those tables.

departure.source: 004_STABILITY_LOADING_MANUAL.pdf §14.1, PDF page 215 (printed 14.1); crew and stores: PDF page 228 (printed 15.12).
departure.note: Documented departure percentages and densities are applied to the current sounding-table capacities. Masses, centres and FSM are recalculated and may differ from the manual; review the resulting condition. Ballast is not part of this consumables preset. Winch oil tank 65 has no loaded filling table and is included as an editable reference weight under Other onboard weights.

conditions.note: Source-based editable starters, not exact replays or approved operating conditions. Current tank capacities, filling-dependent centres and FSM are recalculated. Current installed/stored deck configuration is used, which can differ from the source stowage. Cargo rows are aggregate weights, not individual cargo units. Grain heeling moments marked # are not liquid FSM and are not applied as such.
